name: LiveChat
description_en:
LiveChat is hosted customer messaging software for agents handling website conversations, queues, transfers and customer context. Its current website also sells Text, a distinct platform combining chats, tickets and an AI Agent. New trials are directed to Text; existing LiveChat customers retain their account, plan and price. Treating every current headline as an entitlement of an old LiveChat subscription would misstate the product.

For an illustrative delivery inquiry, collect a department choice, route the visitor to an available agent, use a private supervisory comment if needed, and leave an owned follow-up when nobody can answer. Capacity, pre-chat forms and offline behavior need testing: an inactive chat may reactivate above the agent limit, and a manual invitation bypasses the pre-chat form. This is public-documentation research without an account, migration, widget, AI, payment or export test.
description_zh:
LiveChat 是托管客户消息软件，供客服处理网站对话、队列、转接及客户上下文。当前官网还销售 Text，这是将聊天、工单及 AI Agent 结合的另一平台。新试用进入 Text，既有 LiveChat 客户保留账号、套餐及价格。把所有当前首页功能当成旧 LiveChat 订阅权益，会误述产品。

以假设配送咨询为例，收集部门选项，路由可用客服，必要时由主管私下协助，无人可答时保留明确归属的跟进。容量、聊天前表单及离线行为都需测试：闲置聊天重新活跃后可能超过客服上限，手动邀请会跳过聊天前表单。本稿仅为公开文档研究，未测试账号、迁移、组件、AI、支付或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Handle assigned, queued and offline-unassigned conversations; availability and routing determine entry.
core_features.explanation_zh: 处理已分配、排队及离线未分配会话，入口由可用性与路由决定。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect visitor-provided fields and route group selection, with invitation and campaign exceptions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收集访客自填字段并按部门选择路由，但邀请及营销活动存在例外。

core_features.explanation_en: Supervise colleagues privately and transfer to another agent or group; acceptance and follow-up still need ownership.
core_features.explanation_zh: 私下协助同事并转接其他客服或组，接收及后续处理仍需明确归属。

core_features.explanation_en: Review integrations and license setup before moving to the separate chat, ticket and AI workspace.
core_features.explanation_zh: 迁往独立聊天、工单及 AI 工作区前核对集成与授权配置。

en: Staffed website support with department queues and supervisory help.
Evaluate a supported LiveChat-to-Text move while comparing integrations and account-specific costs.
zh: 有值守人员、部门队列及主管协助的网站支持。
比较集成与账户实际成本，评估受支持的 LiveChat 至 Text 迁移。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit guidance; no observed response-time or sales improvement.

Reactivated capacity.en: Inactive LiveChat chats do not count toward concurrent chat limits. They can become active again and leave an agent above the configured limit.
Reactivated capacity.zh: 闲置 LiveChat 聊天不计入并发限制，重新活跃后可能使客服超过配置上限。

steps.en: Identify whether the account is existing LiveChat, a new Text trial or a reviewed migration; confirm the applicable plan.
steps.zh: 确定账号是既有 LiveChat、新 Text 试用还是已评估迁移，并确认适用套餐。

steps.en: Install the account-generated widget snippet with authorized website edit access, then test the visitor route.
steps.zh: 使用授权网站编辑权限安装账号生成的组件片段，随后测试访客路径。

steps.en: Test all agents busy, manual invitation, idle-reactivation and offline follow-up; verify consent and ownership on every path.
steps.zh: 测试全部客服忙碌、手动邀请、闲置重启及离线跟进，并逐路核对告知及处理归属。

items.scope: Some do not work in Text; migration review is required before assuming portability.

items.en: Manual invitations bypass pre-chat forms, including fields marked required in that form.
items.zh: 手动邀请跳过聊天前表单，包括该表单中设为必填的字段。

items.en: Inactive does not mean the visitor has left; reactivation can exceed the configured concurrent limit.
items.zh: 闲置不代表访客离开，重新活跃可能超过配置并发限制。

items.en: Existing LiveChat plans do not automatically receive the Text features advertised on the migration page.
items.zh: 既有 LiveChat 套餐不会自动获得迁移页宣传的 Text 功能。

items.en: Pricing describes add-on AI packages while current terms authorize automatic refills and changes to subsequent renewal amounts; do not assume a hard spending cap.
items.zh: 价格页描述加购 AI 包，现行条款则授权自动补充并改变后续续费金额，不能假设存在硬性支出上限。

pricing.billing_basis: Separate existing LiveChat and new Text cohorts; per-user billing, annual prepayment, account-wide usage and AI add-ons. No universal normalized starting price.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Existing LiveChat Starter/Team/Business: USD19/49/79 per person/month billed annually,25/59/89 monthly; Enterprise quote. New Text Essential/Growth:19/79 annual monthly equivalent,25/99 monthly; annual totals228/948 per user. Text includes10/200 AI resolutions per account/month; extra50 cost49.50. Terms7.10 authorize automatic AI refill and future renewal impact. Text trial14days without card; taxes extra under terms.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 既有 LiveChat Starter／Team／Business：年付每人月价19／49／79美元，月付25／59／89，Enterprise 询价。新 Text Essential／Growth：年付折合每月19／79，月付25／99，每人年额228／948。Text 每账户每月含10／200次 AI 解决，另50次49.50。条款7.10授权自动补充 AI 并影响后续续费。Text 试用14天无需卡，条款税费另计。

faq.question_en: Is Text simply a renamed LiveChat plan?
faq.question_zh: Text 只是 LiveChat 套餐改名吗？
faq.answer_en: The vendor describes a separate platform and feature mix. Existing LiveChat customers retain their product until a supported move; some integrations and license setups require review.
faq.answer_zh: 厂商描述的是独立平台与功能组合。既有客户在受支持迁移前保留 LiveChat，部分集成及授权配置需审查。

faq.question_en: Does the raw data report include transcripts?
faq.question_zh: 原始数据报告含聊天正文吗？
faq.answer_en: The legal FAQ distinguishes a Web API export including transcripts from a raw data report without them, and limits export initiation to license owners. A complete restoration was not tested.
faq.answer_zh: 法律 FAQ 区分含聊天正文的 Web API 导出与不含正文的原始数据报告，且仅授权所有者可发起导出，未测试完整恢复。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Establish which product the account actually uses
sections.title_zh: 先确定账号实际使用的产品
sections.en:
The old livechatinc.com address leads to livechat.com, whose current pricing page directs new trials to Text. Existing LiveChat customers keep their account, plan, login and price. Text has a different feature mix: chats, tickets and an AI Agent in one workspace. A shared vendor and similar agent interaction do not make the products interchangeable.

The migration page explicitly says its Text features are not included in existing LiveChat plans, including legacy subscriptions. In supported migrations, canned responses, widget settings, routing and core setup can move; some integrations do not work and some license configurations require individual review. The vendor offers side-by-side evaluation and says the current subscription price remains, with most accounts receiving200 AI resolutions monthly. That is a migration statement, not a promise that every new Essential account gets200. The account-specific migration call determines the applicable offer.
sections.zh:
旧 livechatinc.com 地址转向 livechat.com，当前价格页将新试用引入 Text。既有 LiveChat 客户保留账号、套餐、登录及价格。Text 具有不同功能组合，将聊天、工单及 AI Agent 放在一个工作区。同一厂商及相似客服交互不代表产品可互换。

迁移页明确其 Text 功能不含于既有 LiveChat 套餐，包括旧订阅。受支持迁移可迁入快捷回复、组件设置、路由及核心配置；部分集成不可用，部分授权配置需个别核对。厂商提供并行评估，称保留现有订阅价，且多数账户每月获200次 AI 解决。这是迁移说明，不保证每个新 Essential 账号有200次。账户专属迁移核对决定实际权益。

sections.title_en: Route a request and retain accountable follow-up
sections.title_zh: 路由请求并保持跟进归属
sections.en:
Consider a delivery inquiry on an online store. A pre-chat form can collect a name, email and issue, with a group-selection field directing sales or support. These are visitor-supplied details, not proof of identity or order ownership. The agent handbook describes automatic assignment to the agent with the fewest ongoing chats, subject to concurrent capacity; manual selection instead starts customers in the queue. A supervisor can inspect a colleague’s conversation and write a private message, while transfers move it to another agent or group.

When every agent is at capacity, a queue is an operational backlog rather than a resolution guarantee. Configure an owner for missed and offline requests. With widget availability set to Always, messages can appear as unassigned chats for agents to pick up later. The handbook labels its ticket section as a legacy system for customers acquired before June1,2023 and points to HelpDesk.com for complex cases/email. Avoid presenting that old section as the current native Text ticket workflow or a universal LiveChat inclusion.
sections.zh:
以网店配送咨询为例，聊天前表单可采集姓名、邮箱和问题，部门选择字段将销售或支持分开。字段由访客自填，不证明身份或订单所有权。客服手册描述在并发容量内自动分给进行中聊天最少的客服，手动选择则先把客户放入队列。主管可查看同事对话及私下留言，转接可交给其他客服或组。

全员满载时，队列是待办积压，不保证解决。应为遗漏及离线请求指定负责人。组件可用性设为 Always 后，消息可成为未分配聊天，稍后由客服接手。手册将工单章节标为2023年6月1日前获取客户所用的旧系统，并将复杂情况／邮件指向 HelpDesk.com。不能把旧章节当成当前 Text 原生工单流程，或全部 LiveChat 的包含项。

sections.title_en: A quiet conversation still consumes human attention
sections.title_zh: 安静的会话仍可能需要人工处理
sections.en:
LiveChat separates active and inactive chats. Inactive chats are excluded from the concurrency limit, but the visitor may simply need more time. When one becomes active again, the agent can have more chats than the configured cap. Treat the cap as assignment behavior rather than a hard guarantee of maximum workload. Test several old visitors returning while a new chat is assigned.

The list timer resets for agent or customer messages; private supervisor messages do not add the answered mark, and emoji reactions do not change inactivity timeouts or reports. Visible activity is therefore not identical to answering the customer. History continuity can also depend on the visitor not clearing cookies. For order changes or refunds, authenticate through the business’s own trusted process rather than assuming that a familiar chat history authorizes an action.
sections.zh:
LiveChat 区分活跃及闲置聊天。闲置聊天不计入并发限制，但访客可能只需更多时间。其重新活跃后，客服可能持有超过配置上限的聊天。因此上限是分配行为，不是最大工作量的硬保证。应测试多位旧访客在新聊天分配时同时返回。

列表计时会随客服或客户消息重置；主管私信不会增加已回答标记，表情反应也不改变闲置计时或报告。可见活动不等于回答客户。历史连续性也可能取决于访客未清除 cookie。订单修改或退款需走企业可信认证流程，不能认为熟悉的聊天记录就授权了操作。

sections.title_en: Verify data collection on every invitation path
sections.title_zh: 逐条核对邀请路径的数据采集
sections.en:
The pre-chat guide allows required fields and department routing, but says manual invitations do not display the form even when enabled. Campaigns have a separate form-after-campaign switch, and Starter always shows it after a campaign. A required checkbox in one form therefore does not prove that every entry path presents a notice or obtains the same information.

Install the snippet generated by the correct account before the closing body tag, using authorized access to the website or shared template. The installation article now contains separate Text and LiveChat instructions: Text uses Website widgets and a Connected status; existing LiveChat uses Channels > Website. Test the actual product’s normal chat, manual invitation, campaign, returning visitor and offline states. Form templates are generic examples requiring adaptation; this research does not certify legal compliance.
sections.zh:
聊天前指南允许必填字段和部门路由，但明确手动邀请即使启用表单也不会展示。营销活动有单独的活动后表单开关，Starter 在活动后始终显示。因此，一个表单的必填复选框不能证明所有入口都展示告知或取得同样资料。

使用获授权的网站或共享模板访问权限，在 body 结束标签前安装正确账号生成的片段。安装文档现在分列 Text 与 LiveChat：Text 使用 Website widgets 及 Connected 状态，既有 LiveChat 使用 Channels > Website。应测试实际产品的普通聊天、手动邀请、活动、回访及离线状态。表单模板是需调整的通用示例，本研究不认证法律合规。

sections.title_en: Separate legacy seats, new Text allowances and AI refills
sections.title_zh: 区分旧座席、新 Text 额度与 AI 补充
sections.en:
The legacy page explicitly labels prices USD. Existing LiveChat Starter/Team/Business are19/49/79 per person/month on annual billing, versus25/59/89 monthly; Enterprise requires a quote. Starter shows one user,100 tracked visitors and60-day history; Team shows400 visitors and unlimited history; Business shows1,000 visitors. These visitor tracking numbers are not a promise of the same number of staffed simultaneous chats. HelpDesk.com and KnowledgeBase are separate integrations with separate starting prices.

New Text Essential/Growth cost19/79 per user/month billed annually, or25/99 monthly; annual totals are228/948 per user. The included10/200 AI resolutions and50/400 live visitor tracking limits are per account, not multiplied by seats. Extra50 resolutions cost49.50. Essential history/files last60days; Growth history is unlimited, but storage is15GB plus100MB per user rather than unlimited bytes. Included API usage is10,000/20,000 calls monthly; an extra100,000 costs29.50. No icon-only table entitlement was inferred here.

Text’s14-day trial needs no card and does not automatically charge at expiry. Paid subscriptions are different: terms provide recurring renewal, generally no unused-period refund, and tax-exclusive fees. Clause7.10 authorizes automatic AI refills after the allowance and carries increased allowance into later renewal amounts. The sales page’s add-package wording is insufficient evidence of a hard budget stop. Confirm refill controls, cancellation effective date and account-specific billing before production AI traffic.
sections.zh:
旧价格页明确币种为美元。既有 LiveChat Starter／Team／Business 年付每人月价19／49／79，月付25／59／89，Enterprise 询价。Starter 显示1用户、追踪100访客及60天历史；Team 显示400访客及无限历史；Business 显示1,000访客。访客追踪量不保证同量由真人并发接待。HelpDesk.com 与 KnowledgeBase 是独立集成，有另列起价。

新 Text Essential／Growth 年付每人月价19／79，月付25／99，年额228／948。包含10／200次 AI 解决及50／400实时访客追踪，均按账户而非座席倍增。额外50次解决49.50。Essential 会话／文件历史60天；Growth 历史无限，但存储为15GB加每用户100MB，不是无限字节。API 每月含10,000／20,000次，额外100,000次29.50。本稿未从表格纯图标推断权益。

Text 14天试用无需卡，到期不自动扣款。付费订阅不同：条款规定自动续费，通常不退未用期费用，报价不含税。7.10条授权额度后自动补充 AI，并将增加额度计入后续续费。销售页加购包措辞不足以证明硬性预算止损。正式 AI 流量前需确认补充控制、取消生效日与账户计费。

sections.title_en: Choose around staffing, migration and data access
sections.title_zh: 围绕值守、迁移及资料访问选择
sections.en:
LiveChat fits a team prepared to operate website conversations, maintain routing and supervise unanswered requests. Text may suit a buyer seeking an integrated chat/ticket/AI workspace, provided it evaluates that specific product’s allowances and integration support. A legacy LiveChat account cannot be evaluated by copying a new Text feature matrix. Neither product supplies an outsourced human workforce through the reviewed subscription pages.

The legal documentation describes a hosted SaaS service; the terms retain vendor ownership and grant limited rights, not an open-source server distribution. License owners can initiate a Web API data export including transcripts; a raw data report excludes transcripts. This does not establish a tested complete backup or a migration of attachments, permissions and every channel. Data location, deletion timing, restore completeness, third-party channel fees, authenticated actions and real AI quality remain unverified. Chinese prose here is a translation, not confirmation of Chinese agent-interface support.
sections.zh:
LiveChat 适合愿意运营网站会话、维护路由及监督未答请求的团队。Text 可供需要一体聊天／工单／AI 工作区的买家评估，但须核对该具体产品额度及集成支持。旧 LiveChat 账号不能直接套新 Text 功能矩阵。已读订阅页也不表示供应外包真人团队。

法律资料将其描述为托管 SaaS，条款保留厂商所有权并授有限权利，不是开源服务端分发。授权所有者可发起含聊天正文的 Web API 导出，原始数据报告则不含正文。这不证明已测试完整备份，也不证明附件、权限及所有渠道均能迁移。资料位置、删除时限、恢复完整性、第三方渠道费、认证操作及真实 AI 质量仍未核实。本文中文为译稿，不代表中文客服界面已确认。

research_gaps.en: No account, widget, migration, AI response, integration, payment, export or restore tested. Actual migration eligibility, retained price, AI allowance, refill controls and billing require account review. DPA, location, complete deletion/restore, provider fees and UI languages unverified; current native legacy-ticket sunset details not separately established.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账号、组件、迁移、AI 回复、集成、支付、导出或恢复。真实迁移资格、保留价格、AI 额度、补充控制及计费需账户核对。DPA、位置、完整删除／恢复、提供商费及界面语言未核实，当前旧原生工单停用细节未另行建立。
